scope: Local actual React components with synthetic provider script and API responses; no provider payment, OAuth session or hosted acceptance.

results.name: Registration requires sign-in and launches only the configured Google callback
Checkout uses explicit selection and consent without sending browser prices
A provider callback cannot show success when server verification fails
Captured payment conflicts show review guidance without requesting another payment
Interrupted checkout preparation reuses the same request identity
Sold-out live places leave recording checkout available
Mobile checkout exposes accessible labels and readable controls
Dismissed and failed provider attempts show status without fulfillment
Server-confirmed fulfillment returns to checkout history
Admin recovery requires an existing order and retains pending status
